mapper.select: SELECT user_id, password, name, created_at AS createdAt, role, account_status AS accountStatus, failed_login_count AS failedLoginCount, locked_at AS lockedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_id, password, name, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{password}, #{name}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, locked_at = CASE WHEN failed_login_count + 1 >= 5 THEN COALESCE(locked_at, NOW()) ELSE locked_at END WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND locked_at IS NULL
UPDATE users SET failed_login_count = 0, locked_at = NULL, last_login_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND locked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS "userId", name, role, account_status AS "accountStatus", email FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT user_id AS "userId", password, name, role, account_status AS "accountStatus", oidc_issuer AS "oidcIssuer", oidc_subject AS "oidcSubject", email, locked_at AS "lockedAt" FROM users WHERE oidc_issuer=#{issuer} AND oidc_subject=#{subject}

SELECT user_id AS "userId", password, name, role, account_status AS "accountStatus", oidc_issuer AS "oidcIssuer", oidc_subject AS "oidcSubject", email, locked_at AS "lockedAt" FROM users WHERE LOWER(email)=LOWER(#{email}) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LOWER(email)=LOWER(#{email})
